Home.historyText: History pages will use Cloudflare data and keep jackpot history hidden until the data is complete.

AI.regionIntro: Choose a provider to view the public AI preview page. Full outputs stay gated until subscription and ad-credit systems are connected.
AI.signalSummaryText: Plain-language explanation of hot, cold, gap, pattern and provider-specific model signals.
AI.regionAiText: Open provider AI pages for {count} providers in this region.
AI.providerCardText: Preview the AI recommendation surface, core digit area and future hit review for this provider.
AI.coreDigitsText: Provider-specific digit pool generated from the latest known draw and historical signals.
AI.metaDescription: AI recommendation entry pages for 4D number analysis, provider predictions, hit review and future member access.
AI.unlockText: Free users will be able to watch an ad for a one-time unlock. Pro members will get ad-free access and richer AI/history tools.
AI.title: 4D AI Recommendations
AI.howItWorksText: The backend generates cached AI recommendations, the website checks membership or reward credits, then returns the unlocked result. Public pages remain crawlable for SEO and AI discovery.
AI.providerIntro: This public page is prepared for SEO/GEO and future member access. Full AI output will come from cached recommendations after access checks.
AI.sourceUnavailableText: Latest Cloudflare data for this provider is not available right now, so no fake AI signal is shown.
AI.digitFrequencyUnavailable: No latest numbers are available for digit frequency.
AI.coreDigitsPreviewNote: This public preview uses latest draw digit frequency first. Real AI core digits will replace it after cached recommendations and access checks are connected.
AI.previewBasisLocked: Recommendation results require cached AI data and access status.
AI.previewExplanationLocked: Free users can later unlock once by watching an ad, while Pro members can view the full numbers directly.
AI.hitHistoryIntro: This area will show the total prize-level hits across the latest 100 draws. Each record shows five AI recommended numbers and the winning numbers that matched.
AI.hitHistoryComputedText: This is currently calculated from Cloudflare historical results and the public AI core-digit preview. It will be replaced by app-aligned cached AI recommendation history later.
AI.hitHistoryLockedText: This area will show real latest-100-draw AI hit records after the AI recommendation history cache is connected. No fake hit data is shown now.
AI.intro: Tap a provider logo to open its AI recommendation page. Public pages explain the feature for search and AI discovery, while full recommendation output will be unlocked later by Pro membership or rewarded ads.
AI.providerLogoGridText: Select providers directly like the app: tap a logo to enter that AI recommendation page without choosing a region first or pressing another open button.
AI.nextDrawText: A future cache will show core digits and generated 4D sets for the next draw after entitlement or reward checks.
AI.regionMetaDescription: Provider AI recommendation entry pages for {region} 4D results.
AI.hotColdText: Recommendation pages will explain how recent trend windows, cold gaps and provider-specific rules are blended.
AI.hitBacktestText: Past hit review and sample count, shown carefully as informational analysis rather than a guarantee.
AI.lockedPanelText: The visible structure is ready; live recommendation data, entitlement checks and rewarded-ad credits will be connected later.
AI.providerMetaDescription: AI recommendation preview page for {provider}, including future core digits, generated sets and hit review.
AI.backtestText: AI hit history and backtest summaries will help users understand past performance without overclaiming certainty.
AI.recommendedSetsText: Generated 4D combinations derived from the AI core pool and trend profile.
AI.proGateAiText: AI recommendation details and 100-draw hit analysis are available for Pro members. Please log in and upgrade to continue.

Tools.metaTitle: 4D Tools - Search, Hot Cold, Favorites and AI
Tools.metaDescription: 4D tools entry page for number search, hot and cold rankings, favorites, AI recommendations and future member unlocks.
Tools.title: 4D Tools
Tools.intro: Find the main workflows from one place: search a number, review hot and cold trends, manage favorite numbers and open AI recommendation pages by provider.
Tools.statusText: The tool center is public first. Search indexes, favorites sync, rewarded-ad unlocks and member limits will connect after the result and history pages are stable.
Tools.numberSearchText: Search exact and boxed numbers across providers once the Cloudflare history index is connected. Jackpot history stays hidden until the data is complete.
Tools.hotColdText: Show popular and cold numbers by provider and time range using Cloudflare history JSON so the page stays fast for many users.
Tools.hotColdMetaTitle: Hot and Cold 4D Trends - Date Range Analysis
Tools.hotColdMetaDescription: Analyze hot and cold 4D numbers by provider and custom date range using Cloudflare history data.
Tools.hotColdPageIntro: Select providers and a time range, then press Hot 4D or Cold 4D to search each mode separately.
Tools.hotColdDateRangeText: Choose latest 1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 15, 20 or 30 years, or from first draw until today.
Tools.favoritesText: Favorites will save under the user account later, so the same numbers can appear on web and mobile after Google login is connected.
Tools.favoritesMetaDescription: Save favorite 4D numbers locally now, with future account sync for web and mobile app.
Tools.favoritesPageIntro: Save numbers using the same favorite structure as the app: 4D, 6D, package sets, 6/58, 6/55 and 6/50. After Google login and Supabase are connected, favorites can sync to the same account.
Tools.favoritesLocalText: The MVP saves favorites in this browser first. Later this will become Supabase account sync.
Tools.favoritesSyncNoteText: After Google login is connected, favorite numbers will bind to the Supabase user id so web and app share the same list.
Tools.aiText: Open the AI provider pages that are already prepared for SEO/GEO, Pro access and rewarded-ad unlocks.
Tools.workflowTitle: Fast public data, gated premium actions
Tools.cloudflareText: Public search and ranking pages should read prebuilt JSON indexes instead of scanning a database on every request.
Tools.membershipText: Supabase login and subscription status will decide whether users can save favorites and use premium tool limits.
Tools.adsText: Free web users can later receive limited unlock credits after an ad view, similar to the app experience but tracked by account or browser session.
Tools.searchMetaTitle: 4D Number Search - Exact and Boxed Search
Tools.searchMetaDescription: Search 4D numbers by exact or boxed mode across providers using future Cloudflare history indexes.
Tools.searchIntro: This page prepares the real search workflow. The UI is ready; results will connect to Cloudflare search indexes after the index files are generated.
Tools.comingResultText: When Cloudflare search indexes are connected, exact and boxed matches will appear here with provider, draw date, draw number and prize category.
Tools.searchRule1: Exact mode matches the same 4-digit order.
Tools.searchRule2: Boxed mode matches any permutation of the same 4 digits.
Tools.searchRule3: Jackpot history stays hidden until historical jackpot data is complete.
Tools.providerSelectText: Click provider logos to include multiple providers in one search.
Tools.noSearchYet: Enter a number and choose providers to start.
Tools.noResults: No matches found in latest 30 draws.
Tools.noTrendYet: Choose providers and a time range, then press Hot 4D or Cold 4D.
Tools.trendError: Trend data is not available right now.
Tools.noTrendResults: No trend results found for this range.
Tools.proGateSearchText: Multi-provider historical number search is available for Pro members.
Tools.proGateHotColdText: Hot/Cold long-range trend analysis is available for Pro members.

Pricing.metaTitle: 4D AI Pricing - Pro, Rewarded Ads and TNG Pass
Pricing.metaDescription: Compare free access, Pro membership, rewarded-ad unlocks and future TNG fixed-duration passes for 4D AI.
Pricing.title: Pricing and Access
Pricing.intro: Start public and simple: today results remain free, while AI recommendations, advanced tools and larger history limits can be unlocked by Pro membership or rewarded ads later.
Pricing.proPoint4: Favorites sync across web and app
Pricing.tngPoint3: Can be reconciled to the same account
Pricing.tngPoint4: Final gateway depends on supported provider
Pricing.adPoint1: Watch an ad for one-time AI access
Pricing.adPoint3: Credits can be tracked by account or browser session
Pricing.paymentNoteText: Stripe or RevenueCat can manage recurring subscriptions. TNG-style payment is better as a fixed-duration pass through a supported payment gateway, then stored as an entitlement for the same user account.
Pricing.demoPanelText: This local MVP flow lets us test login, plan changes and account visibility before connecting Stripe, RevenueCat or Supabase Auth.
Pricing.syncWarningFallback: Unable to confirm Pro status right now

Account.metaTitle: 4D AI Account - Login, Membership and Favorites
Account.metaDescription: 4D AI account page for future Google login, membership status, rewarded credits and favorite number sync.
Account.title: Account
Account.intro: One account should identify the same user on web and mobile. Google login will connect Supabase Auth, membership entitlement, rewarded credits and favorite numbers later.
Account.loginText: Users will sign in with Google on the website. The same Google identity can be matched with the mobile app account so subscriptions and favorites travel together.
Account.membershipText: After Stripe, RevenueCat or TNG pass payment, the website will read entitlement status from the account and unlock Pro features.
Account.creditsText: Rewarded-ad views can create one-time unlock credits for AI recommendations or selected tools, tracked by account or browser session.
Account.favoritesText: Favorite numbers should live under Supabase user data, so users can keep the same list on web and app.
Account.syncTitle: How web and app recognize the same user
Account.syncText: The safest path is a shared Supabase user id from Google login. Website subscription, TNG pass, rewarded credits and favorites all attach to that user id.
Account.freeNoteText: Latest results, SEO pages and public previews remain readable without login. Login is only required for saved data and premium actions.
Account.demoPanelText: Use this panel to simulate website login and subscription state. It helps us verify pricing and account UX before real payment integration.
Account.syncWarningFallback: Unable to confirm Pro status right now
